subject: Bluebikes Expansion and Infrastructure Updates
overview: The commission met without a quorum to review city infrastructure progress, including new Bluebikes station installations and ongoing bike lane striping. Discussion focused on pedestrian safety concerns regarding state-owned assets and coordinating future infrastructure improvements with school-based advocacy groups.

items.title: Remote Meeting Provisions
items.summary: Lily noted that Governor Healey extended temporary open meeting law provisions regarding remote meetings until March 31, 2025.

items.title: Quorum Check
items.summary: The commission proceeded without a quorum, which prevented any binding decisions or the approval of previous meeting minutes.

items.title: Bluebikes Expansion and Infrastructure Updates
items.summary: Lily announced the installation of two new Bluebikes stations in West Medford and Logan Park and reported that George Street bike lane striping is nearly complete.

items.title: Route 16 Safety Concerns
items.summary: Members discussed rusted railings on the pedestrian bridge and damaged guardrails near Auburn Street, emphasizing the need for increased advocacy toward state agencies for repairs.

items.title: MBTA Bike Cages
items.summary: The commission addressed the lack of activation for locking mechanisms on Green Line bike cages and noted the city's limited influence over these MBTA facilities.

items.title: Postponed Items and Event Coordination
items.summary: Updates were provided on coordination for upcoming family bike rides, while discussions on the speaker series and League of American Bicyclists membership were tabled until the next meeting.

items.title: Safe Routes to School Planning
items.summary: Members discussed potential infrastructure improvements around city schools, using the recent Brooks School project as a model for future safety initiatives.
